about: Four AI-generated strength databases (Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, DeepSeek), parsed. claude/chatgpt: [bodyweight_lb, 5 levels at the 5/25/50/75/95th percentile] per sex; gemini: levels for a 180 lb man (body: u = upper, l = lower body); deepseek: v = levels as a multiple of bodyweight for an 80 kg man (or reps), sf = women factor.
